verdict.rationale: Official docs describe Grok Bot apps for both iPhone and Android, where users can start work, answer questions, approve steps, and review results, and continue the same thread across phone and desktop. An iOS share-sheet integration is also documented, and a runtime probe confirms iOS and Android apps alongside the desktop clients. One hands-on report says GitHub login on iOS was broken; this is a specific bug, not proof the apps don't exist, but it lowers confidence. Missing for 10: evidence of feature parity with desktop (e.g. Agent Computer view, skills and routine management on mobile), Android-specific integrations like sharing, and independent corroboration of a working mobile experience.
